up: List all compounds with exact (i.e., standard_relation = '=' and non-null standard_value) activity measurements for assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3705960. Return the following columns: canonical SMILES from the compound structure, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units from the activity record. Do not restrict to any particular units or activity type. Do not add any other filters or limits.
sql:
SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3705960'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
